title: showcase: declare `excludeSubmitter: true` on one approval flow, and add a checklist item that a declared step refuses self-approval
body:
qa#1 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpxQpmErd1ixfkgbYh

Filing gate: the maintainer's word in the verification seat's session on 2026-11-18. Asked about three product questions from round 2, analysed against the code and prior rulings, the maintainer answered, verbatim: 「三个问题 同意」. This card is the execution of the first answer. No new ruling: ruling 6377731715 on #25496 (letter B for #25446, "default off") stands.

## Why
- **What the runner saw:** a probe beside `approvals.account-app-entry` (QA run #34803, private note) found that a submitter can approve their own invoice sign-off request on the stock showcase.
- **Why that is not a platform gap:** the per-step key `excludeSubmitter` exists and is enforced. It is declared at `packages/spec/src/automation/approval.zod.ts` (docblock around lines 1073–1117, "off by default, and ABSENT when off") and enforced at open, decide, reassign and escalate in `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts`. `showcase_invoice_signoff` (`examples/app-showcase/src/automation/flows/index.ts`) does not declare it, so the platform did what the metadata said.
- **The actual gap is documentation:** `grep -rn excludeSubmitter examples/` finds nothing. The capability is demonstrated nowhere, and no checklist item asserts it.

## Scope
1. **Showcase:** declare `excludeSubmitter: true` on one approval flow that fits segregation of duties (an invoice or payment sign-off).
   - The seeded dev admin holds every approver position (`seed-approval-demo.ts`), so with the submitter excluded that path goes to `admin_rescue` or the node's `onEmptyApprovers`.
   - Make the demo data still show a working path, and say which in the flow's comment.
   - Note: `excludeSubmitter` beside `onEmptyApprovers: 'auto_approve'` is refused at parse (#25635, ruling 6386627950).
2. **Checklist:** add or extend an item in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/approvals.json`. When the step declares the key, the submitter's own decision is refused (403) and the route never silently passes. When it does not declare it, self-approval is allowed by design (the default-off ruling).

## Not in scope
- Changing the default.
- The same person listed twice in `pending_approvers` when they hold two position specs. That is per-spec by design (#28684). A display-level dedupe would be its own small UI card if wanted.

QA-source: #34803 · approvals.account-app-entry · observed beside the clauses
